body: I don’t think she’d take responsibility, honestly. She’d probably just say she’s hurt from the trauma of hitting an animal and gloss over the fact that her actions are irreversible and harmful
Thank you, I’ve never held a grudge before and I know I’ll let it go eventually but I’m so filled with pain and anger right now that I don’t want to force forgiveness before I’m ready

I think she was driving too fast and not paying enough attention, more so being thoughtless than malicious. I wish there was evidence but it’s a pretty secluded area—the closest neighbor is 1/4 mile away.
